Cricket Teams Announced for Duleep Trophy, Bangladesh Captaincy Changes

The Duleep Trophy squads have been announced, with Ishan Kishan named captain and Vaibhav Suryavanshi as vice-captain. Mohammed Shami has also been included in the team. Separately, Shakib Al Hasan has been appointed captain of the Bangladesh Tigers for the Asian Legends League. In another development, Bangladesh has removed Mehidy Hasan Miraz from captaincy, appointing Litton Das as the new captain.
